Maya: Quick kickoff 026-03-22 00:00 UTC - need final landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Also: launch post, webinar blurb, benchmark callouts, and inbound routing. Who takes what?

AJ: Ill take Hosted + launch post. Will try two hero directions (concise vs benefit-led) and two CTA variants.

Sam: Dedicated for me. Ill write the SLA copy and a short technical blurb about reserved GPU pools + autoscaling.

Bea: Private copy + compliance spec + the inbound lead routing sketch. Will add HSM/KMS bullets.

Priya: Benchmarks  I need approved numbers. Also sending persona mapping: Hosted=Startup, Dedicated=Platform, Private=Regulated. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/personas

AJ: Hosted hero candidates:
- "Hosted API: production inference in minutes."
- "Build faster, ship smarter  pay-as-you-go inference."
Which tone?

Sam: Dedicated hero candidates:
- "Reserved capacity, predictable performance."
- "Dedicated GPU pools for production  SLOs and isolation."
I prefer the second with a 1-line subhead about burst capacity.

Bea: Private hero candidates:
- "Private control plane for regulated workloads."
- "VPC & on-prem inference with KMS/HSM + audit logging."
I'll push the second; include compliance checklist bullets.

Maya: CTAs - keep consistent but tiered:
Hosted: Get API key / Try free credits
Dedicated: Request capacity / Talk to solutions
Private: Contact sales / Request compliance brief

AJ: Bench quick-take for copy (label "example numbers"):
```
Small hosted model: p50 ~ 18ms, cost ~ $0.0003/token
Dedicated (quantized): p50 ~ 22ms, cost ~ $0.00012/token
Private on-prem: p50 ~ 16-20ms, infra-dependent
```
Will link to full bench CSV.

dylan-bot: Benchmarks CSV uploaded -> s3://redwood-marketing/benchmarks/2026-03-20/benchmarks.csv :white_check_mark:

Priya: Webinar plan (30-40m):
1) Why serving matters (5m)
2) Routing & fallback demo (10m) - Eng PM demo
3) Dedicated + Private customer stories (10m)
4) Benchmarks walkthrough (7-10m)
5) Live Q&A + CTAs (10-15m)
Speakers: Maya (host), Sam (Dedicated), Bea (Private), Eng PM (demo).

Sam: Can we add a short customer anecdote on Dedicated? Placeholder: "Customer Y moved to Dedicated, cut token costs 35% and reduced p95." Will get approval.

Bea: Inbound routing sketch:
- Hosted signup -> product-led activation -> email nurture
- Dedicated interest -> AE qualification -> capacity planning call
- Private interest -> security intake -> compliance scoping
I'll attach diagram in the doc.

AJ: Tone question: unified landing with anchors for each mode or separate microsites? I vote unified with anchors to keep nav/SEO clean.

Maya: Agreed - unified surface, mode-specific anchors. Growth wants one canonical URL.

Priya: Need approved benchmark figures by Thursday noon to finalize slides.

Maya: Owners + deadlines:
AJ: Hosted copy + launch post draft  Thu EOD
Sam: Dedicated copy + case blurb  Thu EOD
Bea: Private copy + routing doc  Thu EOD
Priya: Webinar slides + bench integration  Fri morning

Bea: Will add two CTA variants per page for A/B.

AJ: Dropping Hosted draft in the shared doc in ~45m -> https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/landing-copy

Sam: Syncing with Eng PM on demo slot. :calendar:

Maya: If blockers surface ping me. Final ship midday Friday so Growth can schedule launch post. :rocket:

Priya: 44D will confirm personas + bench numbers now.
